info.name: Denon SC Live 4
info.author: Jammes Luckett (pka Sister Transistor) // Art Mechanix
info.description: Mapping for Denon SC Live 4 integration with Mixxx. Includes core functions such as decks and mixer channels 1-4, pad modes, Sweep and BPM FX, beatjumps, active loops, meters, and library navigation. Also includes additional features from the controller's screen and helpful enhancements. See the Mixxx manual for the full feature guide. Code adapted from Denon Prime 4 mapping by Levi Williams (Whanake / whanake-music) and RattyDAVE.

option.label: What should the Track Skip buttons do?
option.description: Choose what the |<< and >>| buttons do when pressed.

value.label: Jump to start / end of track

option.label: What should Shift + Sync do?
option.description: Should this combination turn off Sync or turn Quantize on/off?

option.label: Turn on quantize for all decks
option.description: Snaps cues, loops and beat jumps to the beat.

option.label: Start with channel volumes at 0
option.description: A safety net so nothing plays at full volume by surprise.

option.label: When resizing loops, which end locks in place?
option.description: Choose which point stays put when a loop gets longer or shorter.

option.label: Jog wheel sensitivity
option.description: Larger numbers move the track further.

option.label: Tempo Range Preference
option.description: Choose a range group for the tempo faders.

option.label: Which presets have you assigned to the four Sweep FX buttons via the Quick Effects list?
option.description: This may determine the behavior of some effects.

option.label: Fader Echo Style (when activated)
option.description: Default uses Mixxx's Echo. Custom uses your own effect's settings.

option.label: How many bars should Fader Echo last
option.description: Counted from when the fader reaches zero.

option.label: What should the Lighting button do?
option.description: Make sure your recording or live broadcast settings are set up in Mixxx's Preferences. Auto DJ needs tracks in its queue.

option.label: What style of Talkover or mic ducking do you prefer?
option.description: When activating Shift + Mic 1 ON/Talkover, which Mixxx mode should be used? Manual - constant ducking or Auto - listens for audio.
